name: Volo Volo market
subtitle: Volo Volo is a market in the northern part of Moroni.

facts.label: Role
facts.value: Chief commercial area and community centre

facts.label: Older market
facts.value: A separate 'old market' was the central market area in the 19th century

facts.label: Goods (general, an official market in Moroni, not named)
facts.value: Madagascar woodcrafts, embroidered cloths and perfume oils

parts.text: Volo Volo is a market in the northern part of Moroni. EBSCO describes it as one of the city's chief commercial areas and a major community centre.
